messages:
Zoe - People Ops: Short cheat-sheet for managers to kick off self-reviews. Pasteable and skimmable.

Zoe - People Ops: Core template: 3 goals (name + metric), 3 wins, 1 growth area, 1 blocker. Keep each goal summary to one sentence.

Zoe - People Ops: Manager DM (paste):

Hey {{name}}, self-reviews open Apr 1-14. Please reply with:
- 3 wins (bullets)
- For each goal: one metric/signal + one example link
- One growth area + one ask from me
- Any blockers or resource needs

Ben - Eng Manager: Can we add a one-line calibration note for leads?

Zoe - People Ops: Yes: "Cal note: Impact, Reliability, Craft — one sentence per report." Use numeric quick tags if helpful.

Aria - Product Lead: Recommend including up to 3 artifacts (PRs, drafts, dashboards) for each report.

Zoe - People Ops: Added. Also office hours Apr 9 10:00 PT. Late submissions accepted 48h with manager note, then escalate.

hr-bot: Reminder: self-review window opens 2026-04-01 and closes 2026-04-14.

Ben - Eng Manager: I'll paste this in my team channel this afternoon. Thanks!

Zoe - People Ops: Thanks all — reply if you want variants for IC vs Lead.
